newsitem.title: UK: Tamaris in 8.92 mln stg property acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Tamaris in 8.92 mln stg property acquisition.

text.p: British nursing homes operator Tamaris Plc said on Thursday it had agreed to buy a portfolio of offices from Colegate Management Ltd for 8.92 million stg.
The acquisition will be financed by 6.37 million stg of cash, with the remaining 2.55 million coming from the allotment of 92.7 million fully paid Tamaris ordinary shares.
The properties are let to a number of tenants and currently produce yearly a net income, before financing and management costs, of around 1.1 million stg.
Tamaris said it would use the profits from the letting and sales of the properties to finance the expansion of its nursing home business.
